text:
Another ay has triumphed. Truth is there.
+And whoever acts thus, will he not know
+how to train excellent digitigrades
+for the mouse Yes … No … ?
+
+Another ay has triumphed, and against no one.
+O exosmosis of chemically pure water.
+Ah my southerlies. O our divine ones.
+                                    I therefore have the right
+to be green and happy and dangerous, and to be
+the chisel, fear of the rough and vast block;
+to put my foot in it and into laughter.
+
+Absurd, you alone are pure.
+Absurd, only before you is this excess
+sweated out in golden pleasure.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem LXXIII — Another Ay Has Triumphed
translation.editorial_note: Ay is left untranslated as cry, letter, and victorious entity; dijitígrados becomes digitigrades without repairing the bizarre training of creatures for the yes-no mouse.
